message.content: {"class":"TEST_CODE_DEFECT","reasoning":"The unchecked-setup rule decides this: when fixture creation fails and the test carries on, the fault is TEST_CODE_DEFECT. The setup POST omitted currency and returned 422, but createOrder() extracted orderId without checking success, leading to GET /api/v1/orders/null and the asserted 404. The recorded change requiring currency also establishes that the creation requirement changed deliberately."}
